entries.zh: 把头凑上去相磕碰、以头顶撞过去；碰头
entries.en: to butt heads; to knock (heads) against each other
to knock (against something) and fall down; to stumble
entries.notes: 汉字栏「舉着」与音写 ley siô 同西语"碰撞跌倒"对应不直观，主要依西语词轴释义

entries.zh: 绞紧、绞扭（用绞棒/绞盘绞）；绞杀、勒死（施绞刑）
entries.en: to twist/wind tight (as with a stick or windlass); to strangle (execution by the garrote)

entries.zh: 斜侧着力绞夹、用钳斜夹；〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to force at an angle/sideways, gripping with pincers; [truncated in the original — sense uncertain]
entries.notes: 西语释义尾部残缺（仅"forçar ladeando"可读），据汉字"鉗"（夹持）给出部分释义

entries.zh: 绞紧打结；〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to knot/twist tight; [truncated in the original — sense uncertain]
entries.notes: 西语条目残缺且汉字栏为[疑:結/緒]，据"forçar"+結/chûn 暂推绞结义

entries.en: to twist/spin with the fingers; to twirl between the fingers
entries.notes: 汉字栏两读[疑:韏/軬]存疑，据西语"con los dedos"（用手指）与音写 liên 定为捻转

entries.zh: 如搓线般绞动（两者皆用手，后文残缺）；〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to twist as one does thread — both with the [hands]; [truncated in the original]
entries.notes: 西语尾句残缺（疑为 con las manos），汉字栏[疑:接/搔]存疑

entries.zh: 绞细线、捻丝线（綸：细丝线、钓线）
entries.en: to twist like fine thread; to spin fine silk thread/fishing line (綸)

entries.zh: 挼搓成绳、如搓绳般绞转；〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to twist/roll into rope form, as one twists a rope; [garbled and truncated — sense uncertain]
entries.notes: 音写栏中段缺失（"pŷ zo ia…"）且西语"oliton"难解，语义无法定夺

entries.en: to spin/twist thread (打線, to beat/roll thread)
entries.notes: 音写栏尾注"L hūn."含义不明，主释义据打線与"forçar hilo"两栏

entries.zh: 挼转、像搓绳般来回捻转
entries.en: to twist round and round, as one twists a rope
entries.notes: 汉字栏中间字[疑:辡/辦]存疑，依音写 pŷ lîn fûi（挼—转—拧转）释义

entries.zh: 强令屈从、迫使曲从（曲意顺从权势/官府）
entries.en: to force/bend justice; to compel compliance, to bend (someone) to obedience

entries.notes: 汉字栏[疑:辡/辦]存疑；西语所比"passo"含义不明，依音写 cà lîn fûi（绞—转）释义

entries.zh: 在手上搓线（掌中搓捻线）；〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to twist/spin the thread in the hand (by rolling/rubbing); [truncated in the original]
entries.notes: 西语"con…"后残缺，据搔線/có çoa（搓线）给出部分释义

entries.zh: 在手上搓捻线、单线独捻（不用纺具）
entries.en: to twist thread in the hand; a single-thread twist (a hilo solo)
entries.notes: 汉字栏两读[疑:綀撐/綵撐]存疑，据西语注"a hilo solo"（单根线）与音写定义

entries.zh: 反复扭转、一圈圈地绞紧
entries.en: to twist by turning, round and round
entries.notes: 汉字栏[疑:辡/辦]存疑，依音写 chûn lîn fûi 与西语"dando bueltas"释义

entries.zh: 歪向这一边或那一边、扭歪偏向一边
entries.en: twisted/leaning crooked to this side or that side

entries.notes: 西语 forro（衬里/罩套）与汉字栏鸟名两读（音写 cá lêng 疑为鶺鴒）互不相证，语义无法定夺
